- Session-less wakes: the recent-direct-session fallback is deleted; session-less sentinels route the notice only through the system main session's own deliverable route and keep the wake in that session with the system agent.
- Settle PID: the settle window requires a concrete runtime PID when `requireRunningService` is set, except on `win32`, where scheduled tasks can legitimately run without an observed PID (`src/daemon/schtasks-runtime.ts`).
